s10.title: Recorded Audio Blogpost

crit.title: Communicate a range of ideas, facts, and opinions.

4: Communicates a wide range of ideas, facts, and opinions with exceptional clarity and depth.
Provides vivid descriptions, specific examples, and thoughtful personal reflections.
Delivers a highly engaging, coherent, and well-developed audio blogpost.
3.5: Communicates varied ideas, facts, and opinions clearly and confidently.
Includes relevant details, examples, and meaningful personal reflections.
Presents an engaging and logically developed audio blogpost with minor weaknesses.
3: Communicates relevant ideas, facts, and opinions with generally clear explanations.
Provides sufficient supporting details and examples, although some ideas lack depth.
Presents a mostly coherent audio blogpost with occasional gaps in development.
2.5: Communicates several relevant ideas and facts, but opinions are not fully developed.
Provides some examples and descriptions, although details are limited or repetitive.
Presents an understandable audio blogpost with uneven development.
2: Communicates basic ideas and facts with limited elaboration.
Expresses simple opinions but provides few supporting details or examples.
Presents an audio blogpost that is partially developed and occasionally difficult to follow.
1.5: Communicates a narrow range of ideas and facts with minimal explanation.
Provides vague descriptions and rarely supports opinions with relevant examples.
Presents a fragmented audio blogpost with significant gaps in content.
1: Communicates very few relevant ideas, facts, or opinions.
Provides little or no meaningful description, explanation, or personal reflection.
Presents an incomplete or largely unclear audio blogpost with insufficient content.

s10.name: Stage 10 – Recorded Audio Blogpost (S1, out of 4)

s9p3.name: Stage 9 – Project 3 Travel Vlog Speaking (9Sc.01–9Sc.02, out of 8)
s9p3.title: Project 3 – Travel Vlog (Speaking)

crit.title: Develop a clear descriptive account or narrative, expanding and supporting main points with details and examples.
crit.focus: Narrative development, clarity, supporting details, and examples

4: Presents a clear, detailed, and engaging account or narrative.
Develops main ideas thoroughly with relevant examples and descriptions.
Communicates ideas confidently with logical progression and strong supporting details.
3: Presents a clear and generally well-organised account or narrative.
Develops most main ideas with appropriate details and examples.
Communicates ideas effectively, although some explanations lack depth.
2: Presents a basic account or narrative with some unclear ideas.
Provides limited details and examples to support main points.
Shows inconsistent organisation and development of ideas.
1: Presents an unclear or incomplete account or narrative.
Provides very few relevant details or supporting examples.
Struggles to organise and communicate main ideas effectively.

crit.title: Ask questions to find out detailed information and to clarify meaning and opinion on a wide range of topics, including unfamiliar topics, and respond accordingly.
crit.focus: In the travel vlog: asking questions on camera to find out detailed information and opinions (interviewing teammates, locals, vendors or guides, or asking viewers), asking follow-up and clarifying questions (e.g. 'What do you mean by…?', 'Why do you recommend…?'), and responding naturally to the answers. Questions on classmates' vlogs are supporting evidence.

4: Asks a range of clear, open and follow-up questions in the vlog (e.g. interviewing teammates, locals or vendors) to find out detailed information, opinions and recommendations.
Checks and clarifies meaning and opinions naturally (e.g. “So you mean…?”, “Why do you think…?”), including on unfamiliar topics.
Responds to answers appropriately, reacting, commenting and linking them to the vlog’s story, so the interaction feels natural and engaging for viewers.
3: Asks relevant questions in the vlog to find out information and opinions, with some follow-up questions.
Clarifies meaning or opinions some of the time when an answer is unclear.
Responds appropriately to most answers, although reactions are sometimes brief or not developed.
2: Asks a few simple, mostly closed (yes/no) questions in the vlog that gather limited information.
Rarely checks or clarifies meaning or opinions; follow-up questions are missing or clearly scripted.
Gives minimal or repetitive responses to answers; the interaction sounds read from a script.
1: Asks very few or no questions in the vlog, or the questions are unclear or irrelevant.
Does not clarify meaning or opinions.
Gives little or no response to answers; there is almost no interaction with people or viewers.

4: Communicates detailed, insightful, and original ideas.
Develops opinions with convincing reasons and vivid examples.
Provides rich, relevant information and meaningful reflections.
3.5: Communicates a wide range of clear and relevant ideas.
Supports opinions with effective examples and explanations.
Includes detailed information with minor gaps in development.
3: Communicates relevant information and opinions clearly.
Supports most ideas with appropriate examples.
Provides sufficient details, although some lack depth.
2.5: Communicates understandable but occasionally limited ideas.
Provides some explanations and supporting details.
Expresses opinions that are not consistently developed.
2: Communicates basic information and simple opinions.
Provides limited explanations and examples.
Includes ideas that are sometimes unclear or repetitive.
1.5: Communicates a narrow range of ideas and information.
Provides minimal explanation or supporting evidence.
1: Communicates very little relevant information.
Provides almost no supporting examples or explanations.
Presents unclear or largely undeveloped ideas.

crit.title: Organise Ideas into Coherent Text Using a Range of Linking Devices

4: Organises ideas into a highly coherent and logical blogpost.
Uses a sophisticated range of linking devices accurately and naturally.
Creates seamless transitions between paragraphs and events.
3.5: Organises ideas clearly with effective paragraph development.
Uses varied linking devices with only minor errors.
Maintains smooth progression throughout the text.
3: Organises ideas logically with appropriate paragraphs.
Uses a suitable range of linking devices.
Maintains overall coherence despite occasional abrupt transitions.
2.5: Presents ideas in a generally understandable order.
Uses some linking devices, although repetition occurs.
Shows occasional weaknesses in paragraph connections.
2: Shows limited organisation and paragraph development.
Relies mainly on basic linking words.
Includes weak or unclear connections between ideas.
1.5: Presents ideas in a frequently confusing order.
Uses very few appropriate linking devices.
Shows significant weaknesses in coherence and progression.
1: Presents largely disconnected or disorganised ideas.
Uses almost no effective linking devices.
Lacks a clear structure and logical progression.

crit.title: Use a Range of Appropriate Grammatical Structures and Vocabulary

4: Uses a sophisticated range of grammatical structures accurately.
Demonstrates precise, varied, and topic-specific vocabulary.
Makes very few errors, without affecting meaning.
3.5: Uses varied complex grammatical structures effectively.
Demonstrates a strong range of appropriate vocabulary.
Makes minor errors that rarely affect clarity.
3: Uses a suitable combination of simple and complex structures.
Demonstrates generally accurate and varied vocabulary.
Makes occasional grammatical or word-choice errors.
2.5: Uses mostly familiar grammatical structures with some variety.
Demonstrates adequate vocabulary with occasional repetition.
Makes noticeable errors, but meaning remains understandable.
2: Relies heavily on simple grammatical structures.
Uses a limited range of vocabulary.
Makes frequent errors that sometimes affect meaning.
1.5: Uses repetitive or frequently inappropriate vocabulary.
Makes persistent errors that interfere with understanding.
1: Uses extremely limited grammatical structures.
Demonstrates insufficient vocabulary for the task.
Makes serious and frequent errors that obscure meaning.

crit.title: Use Appropriate Register and Style for the Given Purpose and Audience

4: Maintains a highly engaging, authentic, and audience-appropriate blogpost style.
Uses expressive language and an effective personal voice.
Adapts tone and register consistently to the topic and purpose.
3.5: Maintains an engaging and appropriate blogpost style.
Uses descriptive and expressive language effectively.
Demonstrates consistent awareness of audience and purpose, with minor lapses.
3: Uses a generally suitable tone and blogpost style.
Includes appropriate descriptive or personal expressions.
Shows awareness of audience and purpose, with occasional inconsistencies.
2.5: Uses a mostly appropriate but sometimes inconsistent tone.
Includes some attempts at engaging the reader.
Demonstrates developing awareness of blogpost conventions.
2: Uses a basic style with limited audience engagement.
Demonstrates inconsistent register or tone.
Shows limited understanding of blogpost conventions.
1.5: Uses an often inappropriate or inconsistent writing style.
Includes very little personal voice or reader engagement.
Demonstrates weak awareness of audience and purpose.
1: Uses a style unsuitable for the intended audience.
Demonstrates almost no awareness of register or purpose.
Fails to establish a recognisable or engaging blogpost style.
